# Continuia

> AI organizes, matches, and drafts but never diagnoses on its own, and a licensed, board-certified physician reviews every AI-assisted opinion.

A documented specialist second opinion at the point of care, with no formal referral, and consults logged as they happen.

Contact sales@continuia.ai.
